meanings.tr: tavan arası oda, çatı katı odası
meanings.en: a small, often unpleasant room at the top of a house, just under the roof
meanings.exampleEn: The struggling poet lived in a cold garret above the bakery.
meanings.exampleTr: Zorluk çeken şair, fırının üstündeki soğuk bir çatı arası odasında yaşıyordu.

meanings.en: the pedal in a vehicle that you press with your foot to make it go faster
meanings.exampleEn: She pressed the gas pedal and the car sped down the highway.
meanings.exampleTr: Gaz pedalına bastı ve araba otoyolda hızlandı.

meanings.en: the art and knowledge of good eating and cooking
meanings.exampleEn: French gastronomy is admired all over the world.
meanings.exampleTr: Fransız gastronomisi tüm dünyada hayranlıkla karşılanır.

meanings.en: a person who controls access to something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: The assistant acts as a gatekeeper, deciding who gets to meet the CEO.
meanings.exampleTr: Asistan, CEO ile kimin görüşeceğine karar veren bir kapı bekçisi gibi davranır.

meanings.tr: hantal, beceriksiz, sakar (özellikle uzun boylu genç için)
meanings.en: awkward and clumsy in movement or manner, especially of a tall young person
meanings.exampleEn: He was a gawky teenager who kept bumping into furniture.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli mobilyalara çarpan sakar bir gençti.

meanings.tr: aval aval bakmak, ağzı açık bakakalmak
meanings.en: to stare at someone or something in a stupid or rude way
meanings.exampleEn: Passers-by stopped to gawp at the wrecked car.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoldan geçenler hurdaya dönmüş arabaya aval aval bakmak için durdular.

meanings.tr: vay, hadi canım, aa (şaşkınlık ya da coşku)
meanings.en: used to express surprise, enthusiasm, or sympathy
meanings.exampleEn: Gee, I didn't expect you to finish so quickly!
meanings.exampleTr: Vay, bu kadar çabuk bitireceğini beklemiyordum!

meanings.en: general statements that are not specific or detailed
meanings.exampleEn: The speech was full of vague generalities and offered no real plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşma belirsiz genellemelerle doluydu ve gerçek bir plan sunmuyordu.

meanings.en: friendly, cheerful, and pleasant
meanings.exampleEn: Our host was a genial man who made everyone feel welcome.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev sahibimiz herkese kendini hoş hissettiren cana yakın bir adamdı.

meanings.en: capable of destroying germs or bacteria
meanings.exampleEn: The hospital uses a germicidal solution to clean the surfaces.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastane, yüzeyleri temizlemek için mikrop öldürücü bir solüsyon kullanıyor.

meanings.en: (of a seed) to begin to grow and develop
meanings.exampleEn: The seeds will germinate within two weeks if kept warm and moist.
meanings.exampleTr: Tohumlar, sıcak ve nemli tutulursa iki hafta içinde çimlenir.

meanings.en: (of an idea or feeling) to start to develop
meanings.exampleEn: The plan began to germinate during their long conversation.
meanings.exampleTr: Plan, uzun sohbetleri sırasında filizlenmeye başladı.

meanings.tr: jestlerle ilgili, el kol hareketlerine dayalı
meanings.en: relating to or using gestures
meanings.exampleEn: Sign language relies on a rich gestural vocabulary.
meanings.exampleTr: İşaret dili, zengin bir jest dağarcığına dayanır.

meanings.en: to leave a place, or to move out of something such as a vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: Get out of the car; we've arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabadan in; geldik.

meanings.en: used to tell someone forcefully to leave
meanings.exampleEn: He shouted at them to get out of his office.
meanings.exampleTr: Onlara ofisinden defolup gitmelerini bağırdı.

meanings.en: to talk about the most important part of something without wasting time
meanings.exampleEn: Stop rambling and get to the point.
meanings.exampleTr: Lafı dolandırmayı bırak ve sadede gel.

meanings.tr: kiriş, ana taşıyıcı kiriş (çelik veya beton)
meanings.en: a large beam of steel or concrete used to build bridges and buildings
meanings.exampleEn: Steel girders supported the weight of the new bridge.
meanings.exampleTr: Çelik kirişler yeni köprünün ağırlığını taşıyordu.

meanings.en: to give something to many people
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher gave out the exam papers to the students.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen sınav kağıtlarını öğrencilere dağıttı.

meanings.en: to stop working or come to an end
meanings.exampleEn: After ten years the old engine finally gave out.
meanings.exampleTr: On yıl sonra eski motor sonunda tamamen bozuldu.

meanings.tr: alet, aygıt, zımbırtı (adı bilinmeyen küçük cihaz)
meanings.en: a small device or gadget, especially one whose name you do not know
meanings.exampleEn: He bought a clever little gizmo for opening jars.
meanings.exampleTr: Kavanoz açmak için akıllıca küçük bir zımbırtı aldı.

meanings.tr: meyilli set, eğimli toprak siper (kale önündeki)
meanings.en: a gently sloping bank, especially one in front of a fortification
meanings.exampleEn: The attackers had to cross the open glacis under heavy fire.
meanings.exampleTr: Saldırganlar, yoğun ateş altında açık eğimli siperi geçmek zorundaydı.

meanings.tr: sevindirdi, mutlu etti (gladden fiilinin geçmiş hali)
meanings.en: made someone feel pleased or happy (past tense of gladden)
meanings.exampleEn: The news of his recovery gladdened the whole family.
meanings.exampleTr: İyileştiği haberi tüm aileyi sevindirdi.

meanings.en: the feeling of being happy and pleased
meanings.exampleEn: Her heart was filled with gladness at the sight of her old friend.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski arkadaşını görünce kalbi sevinçle doldu.

meanings.en: in a way that shows happiness, often about something bad happening to someone else
meanings.exampleEn: The children gleefully tore open their presents.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar hediyelerini neşeyle yırtarak açtılar.

meanings.tr: parıldamak, ışıldamak (özellikle ıslak veya yağlı yüzey)
meanings.en: to shine because of being wet or oily
meanings.exampleEn: Dewdrops glisten on the grass in the morning sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiy taneleri sabah güneşinde çimenlerin üzerinde parıldıyor.

meanings.en: shining, especially because of being wet
meanings.exampleEn: Her eyes were glistening with tears.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözleri yaşlarla ışıl ışıl parlıyordu.

meanings.tr: başkasının başarısızlığından zevk alan, üstünlük taslayan
meanings.en: showing smug or malicious satisfaction, especially at someone else's misfortune
meanings.exampleEn: His gloating smile annoyed everyone in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Üstünlük taslayan gülümsemesi odadaki herkesi rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: the belief that economic and foreign policy should be planned on a worldwide scale
meanings.exampleEn: Critics of globalism argue that it weakens local industries.
meanings.exampleTr: Küreselciliği eleştirenler, onun yerel sanayileri zayıflattığını savunuyor.

meanings.en: shaped like a globe or ball
meanings.exampleEn: The plant produces small globular fruits.
meanings.exampleTr: Bitki küçük küresel meyveler üretir.

meanings.tr: küreyerel (hem küresel hem yerel özellikleri birleştiren)
meanings.en: combining global and local considerations, especially in business
meanings.exampleEn: The company follows a glocal strategy, adapting global products to local tastes.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, küresel ürünleri yerel zevklere uyarlayan küreyerel bir strateji izliyor.

meanings.en: a feeling of sadness and lack of hope, or a dark and depressing quality
meanings.exampleEn: The gloominess of the weather matched his low mood.
meanings.exampleTr: Havanın kasveti onun düşük ruh haliyle uyuşuyordu.

meanings.en: to look at someone or something in an angry way
meanings.exampleEn: She glowered at him across the table, refusing to speak.
meanings.exampleTr: Masanın karşısından ona öfkeyle baktı, konuşmayı reddetti.

meanings.en: a supply of something that is much greater than can be sold or used
meanings.exampleEn: A glut of oil on the market caused prices to fall sharply.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyasadaki petrol fazlası fiyatların sert şekilde düşmesine neden oldu.

meanings.tr: yaradılışına/inancına ters düşmek, doğasına aykırı olmak
meanings.en: to be different from what is normal or natural for someone, and therefore difficult
meanings.exampleEn: It goes against the grain for her to ask anyone for help.
meanings.exampleTr: Birinden yardım istemek onun yaradılışına ters düşüyor.

meanings.en: to leave your home to do something enjoyable, such as to a restaurant or party
meanings.exampleEn: We're going out for dinner tonight.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu akşam yemeğe çıkıyoruz.

meanings.en: (of a light or fire) to stop burning or shining
meanings.exampleEn: The candle went out when the wind blew.
meanings.exampleTr: Rüzgar esince mum söndü.

meanings.en: to increase in price, amount, or level
meanings.exampleEn: House prices have gone up sharply this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yıl ev fiyatları keskin bir şekilde yükseldi.

meanings.en: to relax and accept a situation rather than trying to change or control it
meanings.exampleEn: Don't plan every detail; just go with the flow.
meanings.exampleTr: Her ayrıntıyı planlama; sadece akışına bırak.

meanings.tr: hırslı ve girişken kişi, başarı peşinde koşan kişi
meanings.en: a person who is energetic, determined, and ambitious about succeeding
meanings.exampleEn: The company is looking for a go-getter to lead its sales team.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, satış ekibine liderlik edecek girişken ve hırslı biri arıyor.

meanings.en: to eat something very quickly and greedily
meanings.exampleEn: He gobbled his breakfast and ran to catch the bus.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahvaltısını hızla tıkındı ve otobüse yetişmek için koştu.

meanings.en: the state or quality of being God; the divine nature
meanings.exampleEn: Theologians have long debated the nature of the godhead.
meanings.exampleTr: İlahiyatçılar uzun süredir tanrısallığın doğasını tartışmışlardır.

meanings.en: the quality of being religious and morally good
meanings.exampleEn: They believed that cleanliness was next to godliness.
meanings.exampleTr: Temizliğin dindarlığa yakın bir erdem olduğuna inanıyorlardı.

meanings.en: the act of leaving a place
meanings.exampleEn: His going was a great loss to the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun gidişi tüm takım için büyük bir kayıptı.

meanings.en: the conditions that affect how easy or difficult it is to do something
meanings.exampleEn: The path was steep, and the going was tough near the summit.
meanings.exampleTr: Patika dikti ve zirveye yakın gidişat zorlaştı.

meanings.en: used to greet someone politely in the afternoon
meanings.exampleEn: Good afternoon, everyone; thank you for coming.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi günler herkese; geldiğiniz için teşekkürler.

meanings.en: used to greet someone politely in the morning
meanings.exampleEn: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
meanings.exampleTr: Günaydın! İyi uyudun mu?

meanings.en: used when leaving someone or going to bed at night
meanings.exampleEn: Good night, sleep well, and see you in the morning.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi geceler, iyi uyu, sabah görüşürüz.

meanings.en: a helpful action that you do for someone
meanings.exampleEn: He did me a good turn by lending me his car.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabasını ödünç vererek bana bir iyilik yaptı.

meanings.en: expressions of hope that good things will happen to someone
meanings.exampleEn: Please send my good wishes to your family.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen ailene iyi dileklerimi ilet.

meanings.en: friendly and pleasant, not easily made angry
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the delays, she stayed good-humored throughout the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Gecikmelere rağmen yolculuk boyunca güler yüzlü kaldı.
